chase-ur.name: Chase Ultimate Rewards
chase-ur.source: TPG October 2026 valuation 2.05; NerdWallet Oct 2026: 1.8 (Sapphire Reserve) or 1.4 (Sapphire Preferred)
chase-ur.note: Transfer 1:1 to World of Hyatt for the best value; Chase Travel pays 1 cent base, with Points Boost up to 1.5 cents (Preferred, hotels), 1.75 cents (Preferred, select premium airfare) or 2 cents (Reserve) on select bookings only. Freedom and no-fee Ink points only transfer to partners if you also hold a Sapphire or Ink Preferred card.

amex-mr.name: American Express Membership Rewards
amex-mr.note: Transfer to airline partners (ANA, Air Canada Aeroplan, Virgin Atlantic, Avianca LifeMiles) for premium cabins; statement credits pay only 0.6 cents, and Amex Travel flights pay 1 cent.

capital-one-miles.name: Capital One miles
capital-one-miles.note: Worth 1 cent each as a statement credit against any travel purchase from the last 90 days (a plain check pays 0.5 cent), 1 cent through Capital One Travel, and more when transferred to airline and hotel partners.

citi-ty.name: Citi ThankYou Rewards
citi-ty.source: TPG October 2026 valuation 1.9; NerdWallet Oct 2026: 1.7 (Strata Premier or Elite) or 1.2 (other Citi cards)
citi-ty.note: Full 1:1 partner transfers (Avianca, Turkish, Wyndham, Flying Blue and others) need a Strata Premier or Strata Elite; Double Cash points alone reach only a few partners, so cash at 1 cent is the fallback. Double Cash, Custom Cash and Strata points transfer to the full partner list only alongside a Strata Premier or Strata Elite.

wells-fargo-points.name: Wells Fargo Rewards
wells-fargo-points.note: Autograph and Autograph Journey points transfer 1:1 to partners such as Air France-KLM Flying Blue, British Airways and Choice; otherwise redeem for cash or travel at 1 cent.

us-bank-points.name: U.S. Bank rewards (Cash+ and Altitude)
us-bank-points.source: Not valued by TPG or NerdWallet in October 2026; Upgraded Points U.S. Bank transfer partner guide, updated Sept 5, 2026 (1 cent deposit, 1 cent travel center)
us-bank-points.note: Cash+ earns cash back, so redeem to a U.S. Bank account or statement credit at 1 cent; the only U.S. Bank cards with airline transfer partners (Altitude Reserve and FlexPerks) are closed to new applicants, and the travel center dropped to 1 cent in December 2025.

bilt-points.name: Bilt Rewards
bilt-points.source: TPG October 2026 valuation 2.2; NerdWallet Oct 2026: 1.8; cash and portal rates from Upgraded Points Bilt Rewards FAQ, updated Oct 20, 2026
bilt-points.note: Transfer 1:1 to World of Hyatt (ratio drops to 4:3 on Jan 1, 2027), Air Canada Aeroplan or Alaska Atmos Rewards; the Bilt travel portal pays 1.25 cents, rent credits about 0.5 cents, and the American Airlines partnership has ended.

delta-skymiles.name: Delta SkyMiles
delta-skymiles.source: TPG valuation panel, October 2026: 1.20; NerdWallet Oct 2026: 1.2
delta-skymiles.note: No award chart; watch for SkyMiles flash sales and domestic main cabin awards, and avoid Pay with Miles on Delta Amex cards, which fixes the value at 1 cent.

united-miles.name: United MileagePlus
united-miles.source: TPG valuation panel, October 2026: 1.20; NerdWallet Oct 2026: 1.2
united-miles.note: Dynamic pricing with no fixed chart; United cardholders see expanded saver award availability, and Star Alliance partner awards booked on united.com are the best use.

southwest-rr.name: Southwest Rapid Rewards
southwest-rr.source: TPG valuation panel, October 2026: 1.25; NerdWallet Oct 2026: 1.4
southwest-rr.note: Points are tied to the cash fare, so the value is steady on any Southwest flight; the Companion Pass is the way to stretch them, and there are no transfer partners.

american-aadvantage.name: American Airlines AAdvantage
american-aadvantage.note: Best value on Web Special economy fares and oneworld partner business class (Qatar, Japan Airlines, Cathay Pacific); earn mainly through Citi and Barclays cobranded cards or Bilt.

jetblue-trueblue.name: JetBlue TrueBlue
jetblue-trueblue.source: TPG valuation panel, October 2026: 1.35; NerdWallet Oct 2026: 1.4
jetblue-trueblue.note: Revenue-based program, so points are worth about the same on any JetBlue fare; transfer from Chase, Amex, Citi or Wells Fargo only when you have a specific flight in mind.

alaska-miles.name: Alaska Airlines Atmos Rewards (formerly Mileage Plan)
alaska-miles.note: Strong oneworld and partner awards (Japan Airlines, Cathay Pacific, Qatar) and distance-based pricing; transfer from Bilt, or earn through the Alaska Visa cards.

hyatt-points.name: World of Hyatt
hyatt-points.note: The most valuable hotel currency thanks to a fixed award chart; transfer from Chase Ultimate Rewards at 1:1 (and from Bilt at 1:1 until Jan 1, 2027, then 4:3) for standard-room awards at category 1 to 4 hotels.

marriott-bonvoy.name: Marriott Bonvoy
marriott-bonvoy.note: Dynamic pricing with a mid-2026 devaluation; the fifth award night is free, and free night certificates can be topped up with points, so earn through cobranded cards rather than transfers.

hilton-honors.name: Hilton Honors
hilton-honors.note: Low per-point value but easy to earn; the fifth award night is free on standard-room stays, and Amex Membership Rewards transfer at 1:2.

ihg-one.name: IHG One Rewards
ihg-one.note: Cardholders get the fourth award night free; buy-points sales and Chase Ultimate Rewards transfers at 1:1 are the main sources beyond the cobranded cards.

aeroplan-points.name: Air Canada Aeroplan
aeroplan-points.note: Distance-based award chart with stopovers for 5,000 points; transfer 1:1 from Chase, Amex, Capital One or Bilt for Star Alliance partner business class.

best-buy-rewards.name: My Best Buy rewards (Best Buy certificates)

bofa-points.name: Bank of America points
bofa-points.note: Worth 1 cent each as a statement credit (Travel Rewards points go against travel and dining purchases; Premium Rewards points can be cash).
